title: Axon Hub | Auto Tap, Auto Rebirth, Auto Hatch & Auto Enchant
features:
Axon Hub for Tap Simulator: Reborn combines Auto Tap, Auto Rebirth, Auto Hatch, Auto Enchant, pet crafting, and Halloween automation in one hub. Build your pet team, automate repetitive tasks, and customize your progression with farming, reward, and minigame controls.

⚡ AUTO TAP & SMART FARMING

- Auto Tap with adjustable tapping speed.
- Auto Rebirth with a selected amount or the best affordable option.
- Smart Progress balances rebirths and egg purchases to improve your power.
- Automatically farm on your highest unlocked island.
- Auto Complete Tutorial.
- Auto Quest and Auto Claim completed quests.
- Auto Unlock Skills with configurable purchase priorities.

🥚 AUTO HATCH & PET MANAGEMENT

- Auto Hatch your selected egg.
- Auto Equip Best pets for Clicks, Gems, or Luck.
- Auto Feed eligible equipped pets to increase their levels.
- Auto Delete unwanted pets with rarity and type filters.
- Keep selected pets and a configurable number of each pet.
- Protection options for enchanted and mutated pets.

💎 AUTO CRAFT & AUTO ENCHANT

- Auto Golden pet crafting.
- Auto Diamond pet crafting.
- Auto Rainbow pet crafting.
- Options to protect equipped pets and saved teams during crafting.
- Auto Enchant your equipped team or selected pets.
- Choose wanted enchants and set individual goals for different pets.
- Optional protection against replacing rare enchants.

🎃 HALLOWEEN EVENT AUTOMATION

- Auto Hallow Lord joins boss fights and taps throughout the encounter.
- Auto Trick or Treat visits houses that are ready.
- Auto Halloween Shop purchases selected items.
- Keep a minimum candy reserve to control event spending.

🎮 MINIGAMES & WORLD EVENTS

- Auto Dig Site.
- Auto Memory Match.
- Auto Wave Defense.
- Auto Pop Balloons and Auto Catch Flying Pigs.
- Auto Cloud Rain and Auto Break Meteors.
- Auto Mystery Egg and Auto Lucky Ducky.
- Auto Island Breakables for ingredient collection.

🎁 REWARDS, POTIONS & BOOSTS

- Auto Claim Offline Rewards, Index Rewards, and Tap Chests.
- Auto Collect Shiny Stars.
- Auto Open Gifts and Auto Spin Wheel.
- Auto Use selected potions.
- Auto Potion Machine with brewing and merging.
- Auto Place selected totems.
- Auto Honey Pot.

⚙️ TRAVEL & EXTRA TOOLS

- Island-climbing and unlock controls.
- Travel between unlocked islands.
- Custom Walk Speed and Jump Power.
- Anti-AFK and Auto Rejoin.
- Low Graphics, FPS controls, and optional 3D-rendering disable.
- Save, load, autoload, import, and export configurations.
- Optional Discord notifications for rare hatches and session summaries.

Purchases, rebirths, crafting, and enchanting use your existing in-game resources. Hatch odds and unlock requirements still apply. Halloween features require the event to be available.
